about_the_game:
Naughty Store Manager is a simulator game where you need to manage a store inherited after your father's death. Along with the store, you also inherited his debt to a yakuza member. The only way out is to upgrade the store and pay off the loan. Fortunately, you have great workers to help you!  What would it lead to? Find out in Naughty Store Manager!

Rin is the daughter of a yakuza member who holds the manager's debt. At her father's request—which couldn’t be refused—she started working at the store. Coming from a privileged background where everything was handed to her, she has become the manager's responsibility to oversee.

Nao is the store's most experienced employee. She is married, with her husband driving her to and from work daily. Though once outgoing, her life has grown monotonous since marriage. Despite this, she maintains a kind and positive attitude toward others. Having not been intimate with her husband for over a decade, she remains sexually unfulfilled. 

  • 14 NSFW animated scenes

  • Stock up those shelves, keep the warehouse tidy, deal with the trash, and don’t skip out on cleaning—customers are lining up at the checkout!

  • Step into the shoes of a supermarket manager with a story full of twists and turns.

  • Take care of your crew, keep their spirits high, and build relationships to uncover what makes them tick!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters involved in sexual content are over the age of 20. It contains explicit adult themes, including female nudity, erotic content. All sexual acts in game are consensual. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
